display.purpose: Game title on the home view only; settles from 0.12em tracking on load.

headline.purpose: Panel and end-screen titles, followed by a 40px strong hairline.

title.purpose: Cult names on menu cards and the rail tide note.

numeral.purpose: Right-aligned scores in the end table, the HUD stats grid and floating combat numbers; tabular figures.

lede.purpose: The one sentence under the home title, max 27em.

control.purpose: Menu button text; nav and segments use 13px at weight 400 with 0.24em / 0.2em.

label.purpose: Field legends and rule terms on a hairline, in ash.

hud-headline.purpose: Tech tree title, followed by the 40px strong hairline.

hud-counter.purpose: Oil total and turn number in the top corners; 26px under 860px.

hud-title.purpose: Selection panel and tech card titles, each followed by the 40px rule.

hud-name.purpose: Recruit names; city names use 15px, lore lines 16px, registry scores 20px.

hud-body.purpose: Panel paragraphs, tech descriptions, toasts and the banner.

hud-note.purpose: Notes, tooltip body, tech count, recruit costs (500, ink), plates at 12px.

hud-button.purpose: HUD button text in spaced capitals; 13px on the large variant.

hud-label.purpose: Faction name, stat captions, tide line, registry tab, section heads, tile captions, tech meta, price tags.

shadows.name: floating-number-legibility
shadows.purpose: Named exception to the No Shadow Rule: only on Bellefair numbers floating over the 3D scene in world space, where no surface sits behind them. Never on cards, controls or labels.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Color, border and fill changes on controls.

motion.name: duration-arrow
motion.purpose: SVG arrow slides 5px on button hover.

motion.name: duration-dot
motion.purpose: Rail nav dot glides to the hovered or focused item.

motion.name: duration-veil
motion.purpose: Reading veil densifies when a panel opens.

motion.name: view-enter
motion.purpose: Views cross-fade in place; end screen uses 0.8s.

motion.name: title-settle
motion.purpose: The home title settles on load.

motion.name: hud-rise
motion.purpose: Selection panel and turn banner entrance.

motion.name: end-turn-ripple
motion.value: 2.2s infinite, 1px amber ring inset -1px to -14px, opacity 0.9 to 0
motion.purpose: Invites ending the turn when nothing is left to do.

motion.name: chevron-fold
motion.purpose: Registry chevron when the registry folds.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All menu and HUD motion removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

scope.fonts: Bellefair and Jost only, self-hosted from public/fonts via @font-face (menu.css and style.css).
scope.unused: src/ui/sigil.js filled, haloed variant (line: false) is not called by any UI and is not part of the system.
scope.notTokens: src/three/* follow the approved art direction "Lanterne & Brume".

components.name: Segmented Choice

components.css: .ds-seg{--mn-ground:#03090b;--mn-rail:rgba(10,20,22,.88);--mn-ink:#e7e2d6;--mn-ash:#b8b09f;--mn-line:rgba(231,226,214,.22);--mn-line-strong:rgba(231,226,214,.55);--mn-amber:#e8a33d;--mn-amber-hi:#f2b75c;--mn-on-amber:#171007;--mn-display:'Bellefair','Times New Roman',serif;--mn-sans:'Jost','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--mn-ease:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);display:flex;width:280px;} .ds-seg button{flex:1;height:48px;font:400 13px/1 var(--mn-sans);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mn-ash);background:rgba(7,15,17,.7);border:1px solid var(--mn-line);border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:color .3s var(--mn-ease),border-color .3s var(--mn-ease),background .3s var(--mn-ease);} .ds-seg button+button{margin-left:-1px;} .ds-seg button:hover{color:var(--mn-ink);} .ds-seg button.on{position:relative;z-index:1;color:var(--mn-amber);background:rgba(232,163,61,.08);border-color:var(--mn-amber);} .ds-seg button:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--mn-ink);outline-offset:4px;}

components.css: .ds-cults{--mn-ground:#03090b;--mn-rail:rgba(10,20,22,.88);--mn-ink:#e7e2d6;--mn-ash:#b8b09f;--mn-line:rgba(231,226,214,.22);--mn-line-strong:rgba(231,226,214,.55);--mn-amber:#e8a33d;--mn-amber-hi:#f2b75c;--mn-on-amber:#171007;--mn-display:'Bellefair','Times New Roman',serif;--mn-sans:'Jost','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--mn-ease:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;width:560px;} .ds-cult{display:grid;grid-template-columns:40px 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto;column-gap:16px;row-gap:4px;align-items:center;padding:16px 18px;text-align:left;color:var(--mn-ink);background:rgba(7,15,17,.7);border:1px solid var(--mn-line);border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .3s var(--mn-ease),background .3s var(--mn-ease);} .ds-cult svg{grid-row:1/3;} .ds-cult .nm{font-family:var(--mn-display);font-size:21px;line-height:1.15;} .ds-cult .mt{font:300 13px/1.45 var(--mn-sans);color:var(--mn-ash);} .ds-cult:hover{border-color:var(--mn-line-strong);} .ds-cult.on{border-color:var(--pick);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pick) 9%,rgba(7,15,17,.8));} .ds-cult:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--mn-ink);outline-offset:4px;}

components.css: .ds-tiles{--mn-ground:#03090b;--mn-surface:rgba(10,20,22,.9);--mn-well:rgba(7,15,17,.7);--mn-ink:#e7e2d6;--mn-ash:#b8b09f;--mn-faint:rgba(231,226,214,.38);--mn-line:rgba(231,226,214,.22);--mn-line-strong:rgba(231,226,214,.55);--mn-amber:#e8a33d;--mn-amber-hi:#f2b75c;--mn-on-amber:#171007;--mn-display:'Bellefair','Times New Roman',serif;--mn-sans:'Jost','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;--mn-ease:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;padding:20px;background:#03090b;} .ds-tile{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0;font:500 11px var(--mn-sans);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mn-ash);background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;transition:color .3s var(--mn-ease);} .ds-tile:hover{color:var(--mn-ink);} .ds-tile .disc{position:relative;width:56px;height:56px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--mn-ink);background:var(--mn-surface);border:1px solid var(--mn-line-strong);transition:background .3s var(--mn-ease),border-color .3s var(--mn-ease);} .ds-tile:hover .disc{border-color:var(--mn-ink);} .ds-tile:active .disc{transform:translateY(1px);} .ds-tile:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--mn-ink);outline-offset:4px;} .ds-tile.big .disc{width:76px;height:76px;} .ds-tile.accent{color:var(--mn-ink);} .ds-tile.accent .disc{color:var(--mn-on-amber);background:var(--mn-amber);border-color:var(--mn-amber);} .ds-tile.accent:hover .disc{background:var(--mn-amber-hi);border-color:var(--mn-amber-hi);} .ds-tile.pulse .disc::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-1px;border:1px solid var(--mn-amber);animation:ds-ripple 2.2s var(--mn-ease) infinite;pointer-events:none;} @keyframes ds-ripple{from{inset:-1px;opacity:.9}to{inset:-14px;opacity:0}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tile .disc::after{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
Ikebana restraint transposed to a night sea. The lit island and its lighthouse in the live 3D scene are the one branch of the arrangement; the interface is the quiet alcove around it, and emptiness does the work. Everything the UI adds is a hairline, a spaced capital, or a large, light serif word set on fog; nothing glows, nothing is rounded except where the world itself draws a circle, nothing is stacked into a column of heavy buttons.

Density follows the surface. The menu is low and deliberate: a full-height fog rail on the left, a main column with one display title, one sentence of lede and a short row of actions, and the right third left to the island. In play, the same alcove becomes four quiet corners around the map: identity and oil top left, turn and tide top right with the cult registry beneath, minimap and two square action tiles bottom right, and the selection panel rising bottom left. The map stays open in the middle. Dread comes from darkness, silence and precision, not ornament.

Warm color is meaningful. Lantern amber marks the action you are invited to take; each cult's own light colors its sigil, its name in the registry, its swatches and its plates. The five branches of forbidden knowledge have their own muted, earthy lights that never repeat a cult color or amber. Everything else is plaster-colored ink and ash on near-black fog.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black fog surfaces, translucent over the live 3D scene in both menu and play.
Bellefair for words that name things and for counted numbers; Jost in letter-spaced capitals for everything you press or read as a label.
Square-cornered hairline controls and cards; amber fills only the action being offered.
No shadows and no glows; the single exception is the legibility shadow under floating combat numbers.
Arrows, chevrons, ticks, oil drops and sigils are drawn (SVG or CSS mask), never typed.
Slow, settling motion on one long-tailed ease.

rules.name: The One Lantern Rule
rules.body: Amber fills only an action being offered: the primary button, the end-turn tile, the learn button, the capture action, and checked or selected marks. Oil numerals and recruit costs stay ink; the only resting amber that is not an action is the small drawn oil drop. If amber is on something that cannot be pressed or chosen, remove it.

rules.name: The Cult Light Rule
rules.body: A cult color appears only where that cult is being identified: its sigil, its name, its swatch, its plates and pips. Never as a section color, a status color or ornament; status has its own colors (Vigil Green, Tide Pale, Wound).

rules.name: The Separate Branches Rule
rules.body: Tech branches never borrow a cult color or amber; a lit link or node reads as knowledge, not as a cult.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bellefair names and counts; Jost instructs. Anything clickable or any label is Jost in spaced capitals; Bellefair is never uppercase-tracked, and Jost never sets a title or a counted total.

rules.name: The Light Weight Rule
rules.body: Bellefair stays at 400 and Jost reading text at 300. Weight 500 is reserved for button text, labels, costs and inline bold names.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow and nothing glows. Separation is a 1px hairline or a change of translucent fill. The one named exception is the floating-number text shadow above; no card, control or label may use it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every edge is a 1px line at 22% or 55% plaster ink; selection changes the line's color (amber or a cult or branch light), not its weight. The only heavier rings are drawn marks: sigil strokes (1.2 to 1.5px) and the 1.5px ring of an available tech node.

dos: **Do** keep amber for the action being offered: one primary per menu view, and in play only the end-turn tile, the capture action and the learn button; every other action is a hairline button.
**Do** set counted numbers (oil, turn, scores, stats, damage) in Bellefair with tabular figures, in ink, and every control or label in Jost spaced capitals (0.2 to 0.28em).
**Do** draw every edge as a 1px hairline (22% or 55% plaster ink) and keep corners square; let circles appear only as sigils, the nav dot and tech nodes.
**Do** draw arrows, chevrons, ticks, icons, drops and sigils as thin strokes or masks in currentColor, a cult light or a branch light.
**Do** identify a cult with its light and a small square (8px owner swatch, 6px toast swatch, 3px pips), never with a colored surface.
**Do** keep the HUD in the four corners at 16px and leave the middle of the map open.
**Do** move on the shared ease cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1): 0.3s for color, 0.45s for the nav dot and HUD rises, 0.6 to 0.8s for menu entrances, and honor reduced motion by removing all of it.
donts: **Don't** use rounded, filled button stacks, gothic display faces, or glowing ornament; the user rejected all three.
**Don't** add box shadows or glows to any surface or control; the floating-number text shadow is the only exception and stays on world-space numbers.
**Don't** color oil totals, costs or other figures amber; only the drawn drop carries the lantern.
**Don't** let a tech branch or a status (tide, wound, health) reuse a cult color or amber.
**Don't** use amber or a cult color as decoration, section color or background fill beyond the documented 5 to 9% washes.
**Don't** type arrows or icons as text glyphs or icon fonts.
**Don't** place UI over the right third of the menu home view, where the island and lighthouse live.
